campaign.description: A scripted run of escalating waves with a run-scoped perk choice between each. Clear wave 15 to win.
campaign.name: Campaign

endless_hp.description: The original loop. Miss a target and lose HP. Run ends when HP hits zero. Stack combos for score.
endless_hp.name: Endless

endless_timer.description: Start with a shrinking timer. Every hit buys you more time. Greed keeps you alive; hesitation kills.
endless_timer.name: Time Attack

physics_chaos.description: Targets drift, bounce, and merge. Clicks shove the nearby ones. Reaction under motion.
physics_chaos.name: Chaos
